description: Verify successful LTE and 5G NSA attach and detach procedure of a single UE under excellent radio conditions with 10 consecutive iterations.
preconditions: Single cell scenario activated and unloaded; all other cells powered off
UE (real or emulated) placed at cell center with excellent radio conditions as per Clause 4.6
End-to-end LTE or 5G NSA setup operational with no connectivity issues
testSteps: Start logs to capture call flow and signaling messages
Power ON the UE to initiate attach to LTE or 5G NSA cell
Wait for successful attach confirmation (attach request and attach complete messages)
Power OFF the UE to initiate detach from the network
Wait for successful detach confirmation (detach request and detach accept messages)
Stop and save the test logs
Repeat steps 2 to 6 for a total of 10 iterations
Record attach success rate, detach success rate, and attach latency for each iteration
expectedResults: Attach and detach procedures complete successfully for all 10 iterations with 100% success rate
Attach latency recorded with minimum, average and maximum values within acceptable limits
UE is attached to the correct cell as per PCI, Global eNB/gNB ID, ARFCN/NR-ARFCN
No connectivity issues or failures during attach or detach
Logs contain expected signaling messages per 3GPP TS 23.401 and TS 37.340
postconditions: UE detached and network resources released
Test logs saved and KPIs recorded in test report
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for attach and detach message flows and confirm success
Check UE logs or applications for correct cell attachment parameters
Calculate attach latency from logs

testSteps: Start logs to capture call flow and signaling messages

Stop and save the test logs
expectedResults: Attach procedure fails or times out
No successful attach confirmation messages received
Appropriate error or failure messages logged
Attach success rate is 0%
UE does not attach to any cell
postconditions: UE remains detached from the network
Test logs saved for failure analysis
verificationMethods: Analyze logs for attach request and absence of attach complete messages
Check for error codes or reject messages in signaling
Confirm no cell attachment in UE logs

Verify SN sends SN Status Transfer message and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report message
Verify SN releases UE context upon UE Context Release message
Capture signaling and data forwarding coordination
expectedResults: Secondary Node Release procedure completes successfully
UE releases SCG configuration as instructed
Signaling messages exchanged as per 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1
Data forwarding coordinated without service gaps
Network resources on SN released properly
postconditions: Secondary node context released from SN
UE continues operation on MN only
Logs saved for procedure validation
verificationMethods: Analyze signaling logs for message sequences and timings
Verify UE RRC state changes
Check data forwarding and usage reports
Confirm UE context release on SN
